pages.text: $(italic)Pure tank. Maximum survivability, minimum offense. The immovable object.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: +20%  |  Equipment HP: Normal  |  Damage Modifier: -15% all damage

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Fortification$(/bold) — +20% armor effectiveness, +15% shield block angle, +40% knockback resistance.$(br2)$(bold)Aggro Pulse$(/bold) — Every 10s in combat: nearby mobs (12 blocks) prioritize targeting the Vanguard.$(br2)$(bold)Retribution$(/bold) — When hit: reflect 10% damage as magic. When blocking: reflect 20% instead. Vanguard's main damage source.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Endurance$(/bold) — Damage taken reduced by 1% for every 5% max HP missing (max -20% at 0 HP). Gets tankier as HP drops.$(br2)$(bold)Ironclad$(/bold) — Immune to armor-piercing up to 50%. Equipment durability loss from combat -25%.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Unbreakable$(/bold)$(br)+50% DR, immune to knockback and all CC for 8 seconds. Aggro Pulse triggers every 2s instead of every 10s. 120s cooldown.
